title: Ad Banner Resizer
description: Reusable vertical structure for a narrow software product that transforms advertising creatives into channel-specific formats.

pages.purpose: Explain the product and provide the primary product action.
Present supported output formats or format groups.
Explain a specific advertising workflow or use case.
Present pricing when it is public.

conditional_rules.then: Include pricing in the product structure.

conditional_rules.if: A format or use case requires substantial explanation.
conditional_rules.then: Represent it with a dedicated page type.

constraints: Supported formats and exact output guarantees must come from verified product data.
Do not infer advertising-platform moderation guarantees.
